data.customer_say: Customers find the floor lamp easy to assemble and appreciate its amazing light quality, beautiful appearance, and good value for money. The foot pedal switch is a convenient feature, and customers like that it provides bright light. While some customers find it sturdy, others report that it can easily topple over.
